patch_description: Proposed cross-over: merge the symmetry-driven hierarchical base (pre/post RZ and RY layers) with a ring-based entanglement motif using CRX on the outer ring, followed by hub entanglement using CRY from the center to edge qubits. This combines the best aspects observed in the two reference implementations: symmetry-aware parameter sharing (efficiency) and a richer, cross-architecture entanglement pattern (potentially improving validation/test performance). The ansatz still respects the adjacency constraints and reuses shared parameters across the ring and hub gates to maintain a compact parameterization. The resulting ANSATZ_SPEC should yield improved generalization while keeping the same input/output behavior as the original program.
